title: Neural network guides design of new fluorescent heteroatom-functionalised maleimides
summary: An artificial neural network trained on an extensive set of measured UV/visible spectra of functionalised maleimides in different solvents related structure and solvent to emission characteristics. The predictor was used to derive design principles for new maleimides with targeted photophysical properties. Several new maleimides were then synthesised and characterised. The abstract does not state how many compounds were made or the prediction error.
